chunks.subject: AP Physics C: E&M
chunks.title: Q1 Mathematical Routines (MR) — 10 points
chunks.content: AP Physics C: E&M FRQ 1 is Mathematical Routines (MR), 10 points, scored by lettered sub-points. The MR task requires multi-step (often calculus-based) derivations/calculations with correct physics relationships, substitutions, and consistent expressions. Q1 topic: charge and a capacitor (electric field/potential, capacitance, or charge distribution). Points reward the correct governing relationship (e.g., Gauss's law, C=Q/V, integration for potential), correct setup and limits, and final expressions consistent with earlier parts. Common failure: wrong integral setup or limits; skipping the governing law; expressions inconsistent with prior parts.

chunks.title: Q1 exemplar — Sample 1A, 9/10
chunks.content: Q1 (MR) scored 9/10 — nearly all sub-points, with correct E&M relationships, calculus setup, and consistent final expressions, losing one point on a minor step. Near-full-credit model.

chunks.title: Q1 exemplar — Sample 1B, 6/10
chunks.content: Q1 (MR) scored 6/10 — earned the setup and several relationships but lost points on the integral/derivation steps or consistency-dependent final expressions. Illustrates a partially completed calculus-based routine.

chunks.subject: AP Physics C: E&M

chunks.content: Q1 (MR) scored 3/10 — earned only a few sub-points (e.g., the governing law statement), losing the setup, integration, and consistent final expressions. Illustrates a response that cannot carry out the multistep derivation.
